prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) proved helpful (+3.0% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests, while 3 showed no clear effect and 1 was stopped early.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) were helpful (+4.2% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Choose path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) were helpful (+2.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests and consistently too high for tests showing no clear effect or performing poorly.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +4.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -8.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -7.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.0% after noise correction, 7 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 75.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive playstyle preference flow in adoption: Adds an interactive playstyle choice sub-flow screen where users set their desktop pet's activity level before completing the adoption certificate. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 75.2% with a long mean duration (1017s). Interactive adoption sub-flows previously achieved +4.2% lift.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop overlay quick guide screen: Adds a dedicated visual guide screen right before finishing onboarding that demonstrates basic desktop controls. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple queries regarding how to interact with or control the desktop pet after setup.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Photo submission confirmation step: Inserts a photo review screen allowing users to confirm custom photo uploads before triggering backend generation. (why: Support received multiple tickets about custom pet creation failing or producing unexpected results after photo upload.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after generation waiting step: Moves the sign-in step after pet generation waiting screen so users complete account creation right before entering home intro. (why: Sign-in reordering has proven consistently positive (+3.0% average lift) across tests by letting users experience pet creation before registering.)
4: [home, wait_info] Real-time generation progress indicators: Enables progress bar and estimated time remaining during the pet generation wait screen. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; clear waiting updates reduce drop-off and perceived wait duration.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Desktop companion focus copy update: Updates headline and body copy on choose_path screen to highlight instant desktop companionship and lightweight app footprint. (why: Clear value messaging at choose_path helps set expectations early and boosts conversion from 80.6%.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Account retrieval guidance hint on sign-in: Adds an explanatory hint on the sign-in screen guiding returning users to sign in with their existing account to retrieve saved pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary or fresh account.)
7: [adoption, layout] Checklist layout redesign for photo upload screen: Changes the layout of the photo upload screen to a checklist style displaying key photo criteria. (why: Adoption completion is 75.2% and photo upload quality issues lead to support requests regarding custom pet appearance.)

scores.note: Proven positive pattern (+4.2% avg) for adoption new_flow, though requires adding sub-flow screens.
High evidence from finish drop-off and support, but adding new screens near finish previously reduced lift.
Directly addresses custom pet support tickets, but extra review screen adds friction and evidence is thin.
High confidence backed by 7 prior tests (+3.0% avg), though reordering requires release effort.
Targets extreme wait duration (2336s mean) with quick configuration/indicator toggle.
Low cost text update for choose_path step, aligned with positive historical choose_path tweaks.
Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) addressed via simple config text hint.
